title: Ratebook harmonization pilot + SQ automation for enterprise renewals
creator: Maya Chen
description: Run a controlled pilot to harmonize enterprise ratebook entries and automate responses to common Security Questionnaire (SQ) items for renewals. Goal is to reduce time-to-quote, eliminate ad-hoc discounting, and reduce manual SSO/SQ back-and-forth during renewals. Deliverables: canonical ratebook CSV, discount guardrail matrix, an automated SQ response mapping for top-10 SQ items, and telemetry to measure revenue leakage and quote lead time. This ticket coordinates PM/Finance/Legal/Eng to ship the pilot and a short playbook to scale if successful.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Canonical ratebook uploaded and accepted by Finance and Legal; 2) Pilot applied to 3 selected enterprise renewals with no manual pricing exceptions beyond guardrails; 3) Automated SQ responses cover >=70% of questions encountered in the pilot dataset; 4) Dashboard shows reduction in time-to-quote by >=20% for pilot accounts; 5) Documentation and rollback plan published in Confluence.
tasks: Finalize canonical ratebook schema and fields (Finance)
Build discount guardrail matrix and exception workflow (Finance + Legal)
Map top-25 historical SQ items to templated answers and owner contacts (PM)
Implement a simple SQ-automation service that suggests answers and metadata (ENG)
Create pilot config in CRM to route renewal quotes through new ratebook (Platform)
Dashboards: time-to-quote, discount utilization, revenue leakage estimate (Analytics)
Legal signoff on templated SQ replies and evidence buckets
Run pilot on three renewals and collect metrics
Post-pilot review and decision: scale / iterate / abandon
decisions: Use purchase-power bands instead of ad-hoc percent discounts to reduce combinatoric exceptions
Automated SQ replies will be suggestions, not final answers — Legal must sign the final SQ in the first release
Pilot scope limited to renewals only for low-risk customers (no on-prem air-gapped customers)
Exception approvals reserved to Finance managers via a single Slack workflow and audit log
